context: Hina-young and Sho-young discuss American culture they saw in a film.
purpose: Two siblings comparing cultures from media.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえちゃん、アメリカの映画、面白かった!
lines.en: Sis, that American movie was so cool!
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered enthusiasm. Quick attack. Warm and genuinely excited—the kind of joy a six-year-old has when he wants to share something right now. No self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 外国の文化、私たちと違うね。
lines.en: The way other countries do things is really different from us, isn't it?
lines.style: Curious and observant, speaking a thought out loud. Gentle, wondering tone. Pace slightly slower—she's noticing something and turning it over. Warm but genuinely thinking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 日本人にとって、新鮮な感じ。
lines.en: It feels kind of new to us Japanese people.
lines.style: Soft, genuine reflection. Quiet confidence in the observation. Steady pace. Not performing—just saying something true. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 違いはあるけれど、心は同じ。
lines.en: But even though things are different, hearts are the same, aren't they?
lines.style: Philosophical but not preachy. Gentle opening. Quiet certainty underneath. Pace calm and measured. Trailing slightly at the end—checking if he's following, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やはり、家族の話、共通だね。
lines.en: Yeah—families are the same story everywhere, I think.
lines.style: Soft, genuine realization. Small voice—he's noticing something important and saying it carefully. Warm and reflective. Slight pause before 'I think,' like he's sure but also wondering.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: いろんな映画、もっと観たい。
lines.en: I want to watch so many more movies.
lines.style: Eager but not demanding. Bright, open enthusiasm. Light pace. The kind of excitement that invites someone in rather than performing for them. Genuine desire.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Warm, cheerful agreement. Quick, bright opening. Genuine invitation—not commanding, suggesting. Soft warm close. The voice of wanting to share something again.
